claims: The word "real" stems from the Latin reālis ("actual").
The Latin reālis is derived from res ("thing").
The word "real" has also historically referred to a Spanish silver coin (real).
The Brazilian real is a currency.
The plural of the Brazilian real is reais.
"For real" means honestly, truly, or seriously.
"The real McCoy" means the genuine article.
"Real estate" means property consisting of land or buildings.
"Real time" means the actual time during which a process occurs.
"Real earnings" means earnings adjusted for inflation.
